message:
Let me look at the git history for commits related to array index validation fixes, and search for known CVEs in proj.4 related to array lookup.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4 && git log --all --oneline | head -50 && echo "---" && grep -rn "pj_param\|pj_mkparam" src/*.c | grep -i "array\|index\|\[" | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
